title: The Goal of the Team
summary: The Zura team's common goal is to be professionals — people who do things well and keep doing well.

paragraphs: This is the common goal of the Zura team. It is not the same as the vision and mission of Zura Spa. Zura Spa exists to serve clients. The Zura team exists to become professionals who can be trusted to deliver that service.
The team's common goal is to be professionals. That means: learn how to, show you can, and ensure that you can do things well and keep doing well.

sections.title: Learn how to
paragraphs: A professional does not pretend to already know everything. Every team member is expected to learn how to do the work to the Zura standard — skills, routines, communication, hygiene, teamwork, and character.

sections.title: Show you can
paragraphs: Learning is not complete until it can be seen. A professional shows, through consistent action, that they can meet the standard without being chased, reminded, or excused.

sections.title: Ensure that you can
paragraphs: A professional does not stop at one good day. They take responsibility for remaining able to do the work well — through practice, humility, honesty, and correction — so the team can depend on them.

sections.title: Do things well and keep doing well
paragraphs: The standing goal of the Zura team is this: do things well, and keep doing well. Excellence is not a one-time performance. It is the habit of remaining professional after the lesson, after the praise, and when nobody is watching.

remember: The Zura team's common goal is to be professionals: learn how to, show you can, and ensure that you can do things well and keep doing well.
